backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing feature requests, user profiles, announcements, assignments with blob storage, study planner tasks with daily/weekly views, and access control with admin/user permissions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four implemented features for the leave application page: calendar date picker, reason dropdown with auto-generated sentences, school/class fields, and live preview panel.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including pages (HomePage, AssignmentFormatPage, StudyPlannerPage, NotesCleanerPage, LeaveApplicationPage, ResumeBuilderPage, RequestFeaturePage), components, hooks, and configuration files.
frontend/.release/production-version.txt: Contains the single numeric value '73' indicating the current production draft version to be promoted to the Live/Production channel.
frontend/.release/README.md: Documentation for production version management explaining how the CI/CD system uses production-version.txt to promote draft versions to the Live/Production channel without rebuilding source code.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with OKLCH color system defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes with student-friendly soft purple/blue primary colors and proper contrast.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with viewport meta tag, page title 'StudentSathi Student Helper Website', root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with all page routes (home, assignment, study planner, notes cleaner, leave application, resume builder, request feature), ThemeProvider for dark mode, and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/AssignmentChatbo: Multi-language AI chatbot component for assignment assistance with voice input/output, image OCR upload via Tesseract.js, chat history, download options (PDF/Word/Text), and content insertion into assignment editor.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout component with sticky header, responsive navigation (desktop/mobile), footer with branding, and renders child routes via Outlet.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Butto: Reusable button component with variants (default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link) and sizes (sm, default, lg, icon), supporting asChild pattern for composition.
Card component primitives including Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, and CardFooter with consistent styling.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Sheet: Sheet (side panel) component with context-based state management, supporting left/right/top/bottom sides, overlay backdrop, and close button.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Toast: Placeholder Toaster component that renders nothing; intended for future toast notification implementation.
frontend/src/components/StudentSathiAssi: AI assistant chat interface with voice recording, image OCR (Tesseract.js), text-to-speech, and assignment generation with confirmation flow. Manages conversation state and integrates with backend mutations.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Dai: Documentation file indicating DailyProgressChart.tsx should remain unchanged during weekly chart fixes.
Displays daily study task progress with a donut chart showing completed vs pending tasks and a stats grid with task counts and total time.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Pro: Container component that conditionally renders DailyProgressChart or WeeklyProgressChart based on viewType prop.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Sub: Renders a colored badge for a subject using color mapping utility to apply consistent styling.
A searchable dropdown component for filtering study tasks by subject, displaying subject names with task counts and highlighting the selected subject.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Wee: Displays a donut chart and statistics showing weekly study progress, including total tasks, completed/pending counts, and total study time for completed tasks only.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout, managing identity state and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query mutations and queries for feature requests, assignment generation (frontend-only), conversation saving, and study planner task management with backend actor integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerSort.t: Hook that persists and manages the study planner sort mode preference (default or dateTime) in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerSubjec: Hook that independently persists subject filter state for daily and weekly views in localStorage, returning the appropriate filter based on active view.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerView.t: Hook that persists the study planner view mode (daily or weekly) in localStorage, defaulting to weekly view.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for theming (light and dark modes) including colors for UI components, charts, and sidebar elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the main App component.
Page component for creating and formatting academic assignments with multilingual UI support, title page configuration, format settings (font, spacing, page numbering), content editor with AI improvement, and export options (PDF/Word/Text) plus reference helpers and teacher checklist.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page displaying a hero section and grid of six tool cards (Assignment Format, Study Planner, Notes Cleaner, Leave Application, Resume Builder, Request Feature) that navigate to respective pages when clicked.
Interactive page for generating student leave applications with real-time preview, allowing users to input personal details, select date ranges, choose leave reasons, and export as PDF or copy to clipboard.
frontend/src/pages/NotesCleanerPage.tsx: Tool page that converts rough notes into clean, formatted text with options for bullet points, definition style, and auto-detected headings, plus copy and download functionality.
frontend/src/pages/RequestFeaturePage.ts: Feature request submission page with a form for students to suggest new tools or features, including optional email field for updates, using a mutation hook to submit requests to the backend.
frontend/src/pages/ResumeBuilderPage.tsx: React component for a resume/CV builder with form inputs for personal info, education, skills, and projects, generating a formatted text resume that can be copied to clipboard.
frontend/src/pages/StudyPlannerPage.tsx: Main Study Planner page component with task management (add/toggle/delete), view switching (daily/weekly), sorting, filtering by subject, progress charts, and PDF/TXT export, supporting both authenticated and guest modes.
frontend/src/utils/leaveApplicationDateF: Date formatting utilities for leave applications using date-fns, including single date formatting, date range formatting, and day calculation between dates.
frontend/src/utils/leaveApplicationLette: Generates a formatted leave application letter string from parameters including student name, school, class, date duration, and reason text.
frontend/src/utils/leaveApplicationPdfEx: Opens a print dialog window with formatted leave application content styled for A4 paper, allowing users to save as PDF with an auto-generated filename.
frontend/src/utils/leaveApplicationReaso: Defines leave reason types and options (sick, family, personal, emergency, other) with corresponding pre-written sentence templates for leave applications.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerBulletSty: Manages bullet style configuration for Notes Cleaner, currently locked to dash style with support for future expansion to dot, number, and arrow styles.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerFormat.ts: Formats raw notes by auto-detecting headings, applying definition styles, splitting into sentences, and adding bullet points with configurable styling.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerTxtDownlo: Downloads cleaned notes as a plain text file with auto-generated or custom filename based on first word and current date.
Parses duration strings (e.g., '30 minutes', '1.5 hours') into minutes and formats minutes back into human-readable duration strings.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerGuestStor: Manages localStorage-based guest mode storage for study planner tasks, providing CRUD operations and handling legacy task migration by stripping deprecated colorOverride fields.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerPdfExport: Generates a printable HTML document from study tasks that opens in a new window with print dialog, creating a PDF-like formatted export with task details and summary statistics.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerSort.ts: Provides deterministic sorting utilities for study tasks with two modes: default (by task ID) and dateTime (chronological with tasks lacking dates sorted last).
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerTaskDateT: Handles conversion between HTML date/time inputs and backend timestamp formats (bigint/number), and formats date/time values for display in the study planner.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerTxtExport: Exports study tasks to a plain text file with Notepad-friendly formatting, including header, summary statistics, and task details with optional date/time and priority fields.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerWeek.ts: Provides weekly date calculation utilities including week start/end determination, date normalization for both backend (bigint nanoseconds) and guest (number milliseconds) formats, and week day index calculation.
frontend/src/utils/subjectColorMapping.t: Centralizes subject-to-color mapping with predefined colors for common subjects, providing functions to retrieve badge and indicator color classes for UI components with dark mode support.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, extended animations, border radius variables, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state file documenting a Student Leave Application Generator with features including calendar date picker, dropdown reasons, live preview panel, PDF export, and mobile-responsive design.
unknown.txt: Requirements document describing an assignment format editor with live word counter, PDF/Word/text download, subject heading panel, citation helper, teacher checklist, and an embedded context-aware 'Student Sathi Assistant' chatbot positioned at bottom-right.
